problem_statement: The request seeks to create a simplified physics-based docking simulation inspired by the classic game Elite. The core problem is to implement a realistic spacecraft docking experience where the user controls a ship approaching a station, with authentic physics (inertia, thrust, rotation) rather than arcade-style movement. The system needs to support both successful docking (soft contact at the airlock) and failure (collision with station hull). The user wants a focused proof-of-concept that captures only the essential docking mechanics, not a full game.
rationale: The request is well-defined with clear acceptance criteria (docking success vs failure), technical constraints (TypeScript backend, single-command startup), and scope boundaries (not a full game, just docking mechanics). XS complexity aligns with the focused scope. No evidence suggests this is infeasible or conflicts with existing work. The physics-based docking simulation is a realistic, bounded technical project that can deliver clear value and is testable through automated means.
